legend: The blasts are intermediate to large in size, with fine chromatin and without morphological features of myeloid or lymphoid differentiation. Immunophenotype by flow cytometry: blasts (red) show low side scatter and express CD45 (dim), CD34, KIT (CD117), and CD123 (dim to negative), and largely lack cytoplasmic myeloperoxidase, cCD3, cCD79a, CD22, CD10, CD19, CD11c, CD14, and CD33. Blasts also lack CD1a, CD2, CD5, CD7, CD11b, CD13, CD15, CD56, and CD64 (not shown).
